text:
maria: FYI tenant 'zephyr-pay' hit sustained 429s on Dedicated pool zpool-09 after a long interactive session. Observed KV cache eviction spikes and slab fragmentation. Support ticket 5821. Raising here to triage.

autoscale-bot: [ALERT] Pool zpool-09: 429 rate > 5% over 3m, autoscale decisions suspended due to shard imbalance. https://console.redwood/p/zpool-09/alerts

liam: Can you paste the top lines from /var/log/redwood/runtime.log and the kv eviction stats? Also which model and seq len were they using?

maria: Logs snippet:
```
2026-03-29T14:02:11Z runtime INFO kv: evict key_count=42312 freed=8MB slab_frag=22% pool=zpool-09 tenant=zephyr-pay
2026-03-29T14:02:12Z runtime WARN alloc: small-alloc-slow path, fragmentation rising
2026-03-29T14:02:13Z proxy WARN throttle: response=429 route=/v1/generate tenant=zephyr-pay
```
Model: rwd-open-13b (quantized), long-session with many appended messages, peak context ~120k tokens.

priya: Noted. Autoscale logs show repeated scale-up attempts failing due to GPU allocation timeouts (kube events: InsufficientMemory on nodes) around the same window.

evie: Customer says this started after they enabled "save-session" which keeps KV entries across sessions.

liam: Sounds like two problems: (1) KV cache pressure from extremely long context + persistent session keeps working set large -> eviction churn + fragmentation, (2) autoscaler on Dedicated can't bring nodes fast enough because of bin-packing and policy backoff. Eviction churn -> increases latency -> more inflight tokens -> more KV pressure -> feedback loop.

maria: Repro steps from support to trigger locally:
```
# reproduce (dev cluster)
FOR i in {1..50}; do
  curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-open-13b\",\"input\":\"'$(yes \"x\" | head -n 2000 | tr -d '\\\\n')'\"}' https://dev.redwood/api/v1/generate
done
```
We saw evict rates spike and 429s after ~30 runs.

liam: Quick mitigations to propose to customer: reduce session persistence TTL (config: session.retention=1h), enable prefix caching (kv.prefix_cache=true), and switch to routed fallback model rwd-open-6b for long sessions.

priya: For platform: add a transient policy to disable session persistence on pools under high evict_rate, and trigger emergency node provisioning with relaxed binpacking to avoid allocation timeouts.

maria: I tested the TTL change on a canary tenant; evict rate dropped ~60% and 429s stopped.

liam: Dev action items:
- run slab compaction job for zpool-09 (job: compaction-2026-03-29)
- add an autoscale override to ignore binpacking for 10m during emergency
- instrument per-tenant kv working set metric (bytes + active keys)

priya: I'll create a PR for autoscaler backoff policy and a dashboard alert for slab_frag > 15% + evict_rate > 100/s.

evie: Customer updated ticket: they accepted the session TTL change and want ETA for permanent fix.

maria: I'll keep them updated. tagging @liam @priya to own runtime/autoscale work. Will follow up with postmortem if root cause confirmed.

liam: Acknowledged. assigning tasks and will post repro logs to gist: https://gist.github.com/rwd/abc123

autoscale-bot: [ACTION] Created incident INC-2026-045, assignee=liam, severity=moderate

maria: closing loop for now; moving to follow-up channel once infra PRs land.
